description: Rochester, NY - Today, former Rochester Mayor Bill Johnson endorsed Joe Morelle in his candidacy for House of Representatives in the 25th Congressional District. Mayor Johnson, the city’s first African-American Mayor, served three terms from 1994-2005.

title: Former Mayor Johnson Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
